probes.name: Uri
probes.note: Not exposed by the reflected peer assemblies; FA's Uris documentation may describe an unreleased or main-branch API. Treat it as forward-compatibility, not a current parity gap.

probes.name: IComparable<T>
probes.note: FA/AA expose Should<T>(IComparable<T>); Jeninnet's ComparableTypeAssertions is currently unreachable from Should().

probes.name: IReadOnlyDictionary<TKey,TValue>
probes.note: FA accepts it structurally through Should(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<,>>); no exact overload was found. An exact overload improves diagnostics and overload selection.

probes.name: KeyValuePair<TKey,TValue>
probes.note: Dictionary overloads accept IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<,>>; a standalone KeyValuePair subject is not a peer feature.

probes.name: JsonElement
probes.note: Not exposed by FA 8.11 (JsonNode only). This is an ecosystem gap rather than direct peer parity.

probes.name: JsonDocument
probes.note: Not exposed by FA 8.11; JsonDocument is common in ASP.NET and System.Text.Json consumers.

probes.name: ParameterInfo
probes.note: AwesomeAssertions 9.6 exposes ParameterInfoAssertions; FA 8.11 does not. This is peer parity with AA.

probes.name: char
probes.note: NFluent exposes char checks through Check.That, not Should(); Jeninnet currently boxes char into ObjectAssertions.
